_comment: Lever board tokens, each verified to return HTTP 200 with a JSON array
84 candidate tokens were probed; only these returned a valid board with
India-located roles. Spotify and a few other global boards resolve but
carry no India postings, so they are omitted rather than shipped as
dead weight -- every configured token costs one request per run.
Only add a board whose public API use and terms have been reviewed.
Set enabled to false to pause one without deleting it.
Re-verify with scripts/verify_public_ats.py before a demo: a renamed
board 404s silently and only costs coverage.
